name: @kitr/kit-fullstack
description: kitr new --kit fullstack: The app kit plus a server-rendered web platform, an API server, actions, api and realtime channels.

kitr.name: fullstack
kitr.title: Fullstack kit
kitr.summary: Start the app kit with a server-rendered site, an API server, actions and realtime channels.

kit.audience: Anyone building an app and its own backend together, in one project and one language.

highlights.title: Rendered on the server
highlights.text: The dashboard kit with SSR, so the first paint has the data and search engines see it.

highlights.title: An API server beside it
highlights.text: `server/routes.ts` serves typed routes to the app and to any other client, with an OpenAPI file.

highlights.title: Actions for the UI
highlights.text: Functions in `app/actions/` run on the server and are called like local functions.

highlights.title: Live updates
highlights.text: A realtime channel in `app/channels/` pushes changes to every open screen.

run: The site on port 3000 and the API on 3001, together
Vitest, starting with the home page test
